text: There is breaking news out of the Middle East and Iran has fired ballistic missiles in the direction of US troops. This just coming through in the last couple of moments. Let's go live to the White House. Our man on the ground there, Jonathan Kersley. What is the Pentagon saying about this, Jono? Fascinating, Laura, that after days of no strikes from either Iran or the United States on each other, we are hearing this from US Central Command. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran in an attempted surprise attack on US forces based in the Middle East. All Iranian missiles were successfully intercepted. US forces remained vigilant and at a high state of readiness. It has been reported that these

Donald Trump and his administration is going to respond to this from the Iran Revolutionary Guard

it's not just lip service. A conversation with full partnership, mutual support, understanding of the
common goal to ensure that Iran does not have nuclear weapons and other goals as well. This is one of the best

But once again tonight, as night falls here in the United States, Laura, there could be more concerns about where the conflict with Iran could be going to next.
